text:
maya: heads up — support just escalated a customer who says they can’t tie invoice lines back to individual requests. they need a forensics path for audit reasons
eli: ugh. do we currently propagate any request id through the billing events?
maya: not consistently. edge proxy sets X-Req-Id sometimes, but it isn't copied into the metering event that lands in the ingest topic.
donna: we definitely have request_id in the debug logs, but not in the billing event schema. that’s why joins fail.
samir: quick idea: add request_id to the canonical billing event envelope (optional string). then downstream aggs can group by request_id when present. tradeoff: larger event size and index cardinality.
maya: +1 for adding it as optional. customer wants ability to submit a list of request ids and get invoice detail for them.
eli: technical caveat: a lot of internal retries will generate the same request id? or we have multiple ids per logical request (client req id vs edge req id). we need a lineage mapping doc.
donna: proposal: normalize to a single field billing_request_id that we fill in at the first trusted ingress (edge/proxy). we map client-provided id -> billing_request_id at ingress, store mapping in header X-Billing-Req.
samir: example proxy config snippet I was thinking of:
```
# envoy filter
add_request_header: "x-billing-req%REQ(X-Req-Id)%"
```
then metering sidecar reads x-billing-req and copies into event.billing_request_id
maya: can we also include a tiny provenance array (e.g. ["edge:host1", "sidecar:v2"]) so we can debug where it was set? small string field.
eli: keep it minimal. provenance is useful but will blow up cardinality. maybe a single origin tag: billing_request_origin.
donna: ops question — if we change the schema, will older aggregators choke? we need contract versioning and graceful fallback.
samir: pipeline change plan: add new optional field, consumers should ignore unknown fields (we already use avro with forward compat). then deploy sidecar change -> canary -> full rollout.
maya: console UX: support a filter in invoice preview to accept billing_request_id and show the matching rows + raw events. product asked for a CSV export for audits.
eli: go/sequence for reconciliation: 1) spec + sample event, 2) proxy + sidecar canary, 3) metering producer change, 4) consumer acceptance tests, 5) console column + export, 6) legal signoff.
legal: @maya thanks — from compliance POV we need to capture the original client id when provided and record the time of mapping. also retention rules may differ if this is PII. please run privacy review before enabling persistence of client ids.
maya: noted. we will treat client_provided_id differently and only persist billing_request_id by default; client_provided_id optional and redacted unless consented.
samir: rollout flags: METADATA_BILLING_REQ=true on canary namespace, METADATA_BILLING_REQ=false elsewhere. sampling: if we enable for all traffic immediately, storage costs spike; consider 1% flame canary then 100% based on metrics.
donna: metrics to watch: event size p50/p95, producer throughput, downstream index cardinality, invoice_preview latency. alert if event size p95 increases > 15%.
maya: quick adhoc SQL we used today to illustrate the join (for support):
```
SELECT b.invoice_id, e.request_id, e.tokens
FROM billing_events b
LEFT JOIN raw_metering_events e ON e.billing_request_id = b.billing_request_id
WHERE b.tenant_id = 'acme' AND b.invoice_date = '2026-02-01';
```
eli: thanks. I'll draft the spec and a sample event example and post it in this thread.
deploy-bot: starting canary deploy for metering-sidecar v2.1 -> ns=canary (ETA ~10m) :rocket:
maya: once canary is up we'll run a few end-to-end tests with synthetic request ids and confirm they appear in the invoice preview export.
legal: also confirm deletion path in case a customer requests erasure.
maya: noted. i'll create the ticket with the checklist and assign owners. tagging @eli @donna @samir for visibility. :thumbsup:
